# Design Priors — Test Project

<!-- Each prior is terse. Fields: axis, lean, inferred-why, corrected-why (when it differs), date. -->

## P-FOCUS — audience breadth
- **axis:** laser-focus on one use-case vs. broad applicability
- **lean:** focus — solo founders only; resist breadth toward agencies/teams
- **inferred-why:** operator rejected the agency generalization in the roadmap
- **corrected-why:** the product's bet is depth-for-one-demographic; breadth dilutes the wedge
- **date:** 2026-06-26

## P-SHIP — performance vs. speed-to-validate
- **axis:** optimize performance vs. ship and learn
- **lean:** speed-to-validate — don't optimize until usage is proven
- **date:** 2026-06-26

## P-DEFAULTS — defaults vs. configurability
- **axis:** opinionated defaults vs. user configurability
- **lean:** opinionated defaults; novice-approachability over power-user surface area
- **inferred-why:** operator asked to collapse a settings wall into one default + hidden advanced
- **corrected-why:** the target user wants one obvious right answer, not a control panel
- **date:** 2026-06-26

## P-ANTI — anti-persona
- **axis:** identity / anti-persona (who this is NOT for)
- **lean:** anti-persona = spreadsheet-lovers; grid/power-user features are off-thesis
- **date:** 2026-06-26
